title: Geologic Map of the Brighton Quadrangle, Hampton and Jasper Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2013, Geologic Map of the Brighton Quadrangle, Hampton and Jasper Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-160, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; the map face is garbled. Flood plain deposits and meander scars under a formation heading are associated with it from the layout and flagged inferred. Symbols: Qe and QPldms are on the same line as their descriptions; QPphr is printed after the Penholoway flood plain deposits (also once beside the Ten Mile Hill flood plain text, so not assigned there); 'QPidms' on the map face not recorded. Thicknesses read '|' for 1 are flagged inferred. Bodies of standing water not recorded as a unit. Portions of Georgia not mapped. The sheet says its products are provided 'as is' without warranty; it has no reference list.
SUBSURFACE: p. 1 gives elevation ranges of each unit's seaward and landward margins (Ten Mile Hill beds 25-35 ft, Ladson Formation 35-57 ft, Penholoway Formation 57-70 ft), stored as unit descriptions. Drill holes 25-186 and 25-187 are plotted with SCGS log numbers but no depths; logs are on file at SCGS. No cross section or structure-contour map. Datum: horizontal 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 10 feet; vertical datum for the elevations not stated.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; the map face is garbled). Units as before (flood plain deposits and meander scars under a formation heading associated from the layout, flagged inferred); map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile. Thicknesses read '|' for 1 flagged inferred. Margin elevations (Ten Mile Hill beds 25/35 ft, Ladson Formation 35/57 ft, Penholoway Formation 57/70 ft, seaward/landward) are recorded as descriptions/contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (25-1xx) plotted by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS). Bodies of standing water and the unmapped Georgia area not recorded; no reference list.
